title: Predictive Maintenance for Building Equipment

blueprintSignals.name: Vibration trend
blueprintSignals.definition: slope of RMS vibration over the last 14 days
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Sensors loosen and drift, so calibrate per sensor

blueprintSignals.name: Efficiency drift
blueprintSignals.definition: rise in kilowatts per ton of cooling or per unit of heat at similar load
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Weather changes the baseline, so normalise by load and temperature

blueprintSignals.name: Runtime hours
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Logging gaps and meter replacements reset the counter

blueprintSignals.name: Fault codes
blueprintSignals.definition: count of controller alarm codes by type in the last 7 days
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Alarms are noisy, so count only the codes linked to failures

engineFeatures.meaning: value minus the median of the same hour of the same weekday in previous weeks
median absolute deviation of recent residuals
known events that are supposed to move the level
persistence of a deviation over several hours
quiet time after an alert so one event raises one alert

label: For "Predictive Maintenance for Building Equipment": Predict failures of building equipment such as chillers, boilers and lifts from sensor data so repairs happen before breakdowns. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Maintenance resets the history, so a repaired machine looks as though it had no problem.
